content.title: Best 4/20 Food Deals: Save on Cookies, Tacos, Wings and More
content.text: The munchies don't care what day it is, but on April 20 they do tend to show up right on schedule. Whether you're fully leaning into 4/20 as an occasion or you just happen to be thinking about food a lot more than usual, it's a day that comes with a specific kind of appetite.What started as a low-key and rebellious ritual has well and truly gone corporate, and the food industry has certainly caught on. And with marijuana now legal in many states, every year more chains are jumping on the 4/20 bandwagon with suspiciously specific prices and deals that very much understand the assignment.Whether you're partaking in this dopest of days, stumbled onto this page because a burger deal caught your eye or you just wanted a free frisbee, we've rounded up every 4/20 deal worth knowing about.Note: While cannabis has been legalized for medical and even recreational use in some states, marijuana and products containing THC is still a Schedule I drug under US federal law. Always exercise caution and judgment when consuming cannabis or any other controlled substance. Wingstop WingstopWingstop is treating this 4/20 like a limited sneaker drop and the energy is appreciated. The Hot Box is back. Score wings or tenders in the returning Fiery Nacho flavor, loaded fries, a drink and a dip. There are also 420 numbered, limited-edition collectible trays up for grabs. These are first come, first served at just four locations through April 20, though. KFC FFCKFC knows exactly what day it is, and it's not playing about it. For $4.20, grab a Chicken Pot Pie combo through the KFC app or website. You'll need a KFC Rewards account to light this one up, and it's only at participating locations. Taco Bell Taco BellTaco Bell is bringing the munchies energy with not one but two deals. Spend $20 or more through DoorDash, Uber Eats or Postmates and get a large Nacho Fries for free. Just remember to add it to your cart. Grubhub users can also grab a free taco on orders of $20 or more. Taco Tuesdays on a Monday, anyone? Delta DeltaDelta the THC seltzer, not the airline. Though, both might have their mile-high fan bases. For anyone sipping their way through 4/20 this year, Delta is taking 25% off sitewide. Spend $150 or more and you can get a free Yeti slim cooler too. The drinks are available in adjustable dosages and easy-going flavors like pink lemonade and tropical mango. Gopuff GopuffGopuff, known for its fast deliveries, is offering tasty treats today. Order Ben & Jerry's through Gopuff and get your pints for only $4.20 today. And if you're a Fam member, you can get $1 Half Baked pints at 4:20 p.m. -- just note that it's limited to one per order. Willie's Remedy Plus Willie's Remedy Plus/CNETWillie Nelson is not only a country music legend. He's also a fan of a specific plant. And he's crafted his own hemp-derived THC drinks to help you relax. From low-dose seltzers to shots and spirits, you can get yours shipped legally from Willie's Remedy Plus. Right now the brand is offering 25% off everything sitewide, making it the perfect time to stock up. Blaze Pizza Blaze Pizza/CNETBlaze Pizza is known for its delicious pizzas, bites, cheesy salads and desserts -- a perfect way to scare the munchies away. They're offering 4/20-specific deals through their app. Keep in mind that this offer varies by location. Twin Peaks Twin PeaksTwin Peaks is offering $6 High Altitude Shots and $8 Peak Haze Cocktails that you can enjoy after indulging in activities that cause the munchies. These deals gel well with their assortment of burgers and appetizers. Deals are open to guests and restaurant patrons. Keep in mind that there are 100+ locations and prices may vary, so make sure to ask your local Twin Peaks for details. 7 Brew 7 Brew/CNET7 Brew is technically not doing a 4/20 promo... but the timing says otherwise. It's launching a gift card promo on April 20. Spend $25 on gift cards and get a free drink card in return. The offer runs through May 17, so you can stock up on caffeine or cold drinks to keep the good vibes going. Voodoo Doughnut Voodoo DoughnutVoodoo Doughnuts woke up and chose chaos for the occasion. Forget your standard doughnuts, because what could be better than doughnuts shaped like a blunt? The Blunt Box gets you six. Deeply unserious and absolutely worth trying. Subway SubwaySubway isn't going full 4/20 mode, but Sub Club members can grab a BOGO deal using the code FLBOGO on app or online orders. The window runs through April 28, so even if the day slips by in a haze, you've still got time to cash in. Fatburger FatburgerFatburger is keeping it blunt. Get Original Fatburgers for $4.20, online only, one day only. No substitutions, no upgrades and no philosophical debates about toppings -- just a solid burger at a price that only makes sense once a year. Check local participation before you get your hopes up, though. 20% off at Woot today only WootNot a food deal per se (though it does include a bunch of grocery and household products), but Woot is offering 20% off a ton of tech and home gear today only when you use code SAVETWENTY at checkout. That includes products from Bose, DeWalt, Samsung, Blueair, Brooks running and many more. Cheba Hut Cheba HutIf any restaurant was going to show up for 4/20, it was always going to be Cheba Hut. The sub chain has built its entire identity around weed culture, so sitting this one out wasn't really an option. For $4.20, grab any Nug, their signature toasted subs, served on a limited "420/2026" commemorative frisbee. Because of course it comes with a frisbee. Chipotle ChipotleChipotle's deal is technically a hockey promo, but today it can match your 4/20 mood. Show up after 3 p.m in a hockey jersey at a participating location and walk out with a BOGO entree. It's in-restaurant only which does mean leaving the house. But sometimes the munchies demand sacrifice. Jimmy Johns Jimmy JohnsJimmy Johns is fully committed to the bit this year. The sandwich-maker is rolling out a Dream Rotation meal: toasted sandwich, Jimmy Chips and a Cereal n' Milk crispy treat, alongside four limited-time meals created by self-proclaimed 4/20 legends. It's a lot. It's supposed to be a lot. Lean into it. Yogurtland YogurtlandYogurtland Real Rewards members get 20% off their swirl every 20th of the month throughout the end of the year and today is a good day as any to start. It's officially part of Yogurtland's 20th anniversary celebration but the timing is perfect for those who have a sweet tooth. Insomnia Cookies Insomnia CookiesInsomnia Cookies has been feeding the weekend right with a buy four, get two free deal ending today, available in-store and via online pickup. Six for the price of four is already a win and we're not here to tell you how many boxes is too many. That's between you and your appetite. Snickers SnickersSnickers is calling this an NFL Draft celebration, but the calendar says April 20. You do the math. Free Ice Cream Chill Bar six-packs are dropping at 12 p.m. EST today. They'll be back again on April 24. Only the first 200 people will score one, though, so you might want to set an alarm. Free ice cream is free ice cream, whatever the occasion.
